admission_and_training.admission_decisions: Recompute the paired lower-endpoint decision from the existing MTG report's target_label_masked macro AUPRC and the same fold-level frequency reference, for the original and both reassigned conditions. Require all three lower endpoints above zero. Do not tune the rule using audio outcomes.
admission_and_training.control_generation: Recreate the two existing fold-specific full-label-set reassignments with the original source function and seed; verify recipient/donor and prevalence integrity before audio fitting.
admission_and_training.fit: One independent binary L2 logistic regression per selected label and condition: C=1.0, class_weight=balanced, solver=liblinear, max_iter=1000. Standardize 80 features using the training fold only. No hyperparameter search, early stopping, or audio-model selection using clean annotations.
admission_and_training.one_class_target: Omit that label-fold block for all conditions and report the omission.
admission_and_training.training_labels: Within each artist fold, use only the 16 labels selected by the original metadata protocol from the nine training folds. Each condition supplies its corresponding uploader-label targets on those same training tracks.

evaluation.aggregation: Average supported labels within each taxonomy and fold, then supported taxonomies equally within the fold, then the ten fold means equally.
evaluation.class_match: Casefold and remove nonalphanumeric characters; require exact normalized match between a selected uploader genre tag and a human-consensus class.
evaluation.interval: Descriptive paired Student-t 95% summary over ten fixed artist folds; shared training tracks limit population interpretation.
evaluation.metric: grouped-tie average precision of audio-model scores against clean consensus one-versus-rest genre labels, computed within each supported taxonomy-label-fold block
evaluation.missing_fold: If any fold has no supported taxonomy after feature exclusions, report the primary study as infeasible; do not lower support after seeing scores.
evaluation.primary_support: At least five positive and one negative clean annotations in a block, and the same track set and complete predictions across all three conditions.
evaluation.secondary: Also report all supported blocks with at least one positive and negative, without changing the primary support rule.
evaluation.split: Ten canonical artist-held-out MTG folds; the audio classifier has no training tracks from the test artists.

feature_vector.exclusions: Exclude tracks with a missing, nonfinite, or wrong-length vector from every condition; report counts and IDs. Do not use metadata, high-level predictions, or consensus annotations as model inputs.
feature_vector.transform: log1p(max(0, value)) on each numeric coordinate

interpretation: A controlled downstream audio genre-classification consequence of admitting reassigned uploader labels on previously studied MTG tracks. The audio features are precomputed, the outcome is independent human-consensus genre, and the design is post-audit; it does not establish song quality, listener preference, a deployed evaluation workflow, or untouched-source confirmation of a replacement admission rule.
population: canonical MTG tracks with complete, checksum-verified official audio features; consensus annotations are used only on held-out tracks for scoring
question: Does using each label source admitted by the tested metadata rule change the performance of an audio genre classifier against independent human-consensus genre labels?

sources.feature_kind: Essentia audio-derived statistical features from the official MTG-Jamendo release
